children: ASP Isotopes hosts inaugural Capital Markets Day in London and says it is transitioning from development into early commercialization with milestones to drive revenues and a $300 million EBITDA target for 2031.
Hosts inaugural Capital Markets Day in London and publishes presentation and press release on investor site.
Says 2026 marks transition to production; expects revenue growth from Phase 1 liquid helium and radiopharmacy expansion.
Plans first commercial shipments from stable isotope division to expand customer base over next 12 months.
Targets more than $300 million of EBITDA by 2031 and pursuing separate public listings for Quantum Leap Energy and Noble Africa.
Provides operational updates and webcast; presentation available and all info is as of Sept 8, 2026 with no obligation to update.
